title: A Choir for the Garden
author: Casper Brightwater
blurb: Mara Winterbourne, the keeper of a gate that should stay shut, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
